answer: Cut-weighted vouch graph: an identity's attestation weight equals its min-cut to the seed set, counted in independent vouch edges. A farmed cluster shares its edges, so adding clones leaves the cut on the same ledge while weight per clone falls toward zero. Each edge must carry a mutual signed pulse every epoch or it decays. Only cuts above a fixed summit earn weight, so a farmer needs distinct established partners per clone and total cost grows quadratically with identity count.
